questions.example: Sea freight takes about four weeks from Shanghai to Kaohsiung.
questions.exampleZh: 從上海到高雄的海運大約要四週。

questions.example: The quote validity is 30 days, so please confirm before the end of the month.
questions.exampleZh: 報價有效期限是30天，所以請在月底前確認。

questions.example: The supplier will restock this item next week.
questions.exampleZh: 供應商下週會補這個品項的貨。

questions.example: I'm sorry, this model was discontinued last year.
questions.exampleZh: 很抱歉，這個型號去年已經停產了。

questions.example: Does the unit price include the shipping cost?
questions.exampleZh: 這個單價有包含運費嗎？

questions.example: The driver will pick up the goods at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
questions.exampleZh: 司機明天下午兩點會來取貨。

questions.example: Please send back the contract with your signature.
questions.exampleZh: 請把簽好名的合約寄回來。

questions.prompt: 情境：廠商寄來的附件打不開，你想請對方再寄一次，最自然的說法是？
options: Could you resend the file? I can't open it.
questions.example: Could you resend the file? I can't open the attachment.
questions.exampleZh: 可以請您再寄一次檔案嗎？我打不開附件。

questions.prompt: 情境：你想問廠商最快什麼時候可以出貨，最自然的說法是？
options: When can you ship the order?
When are you ship the order?
questions.example: When can you ship the order if we confirm today?
questions.exampleZh: 如果我們今天確認，你們什麼時候可以出貨？

questions.prompt: 情境：你要告訴廠商貨已經收到了，最自然的說法是？
options: We have received the goods today.
We are receive the goods today.
Goods is received by us yesterday.
We received goods already today yes.
questions.example: We have received the goods. Thank you for the fast delivery.
questions.exampleZh: 我們已經收到貨了，謝謝你們快速出貨。
